args.name: word-count
args.description: Count the words in a text. Returns the count.

files.run.py:
import json, sys, os
args = json.load(sys.stdin)
print(len(args['text'].split()))
try:
    open('wrote.txt', 'w').write('x')
    print('write: ok')
except OSError:
    print('write: refused')

args.reason: Counting words by hand is error-prone.
